protocol.name: GR00T DiT W8A8-to-W4A4 adaptation of reference progressive protocol; full fresh-vision plan
protocol.timing: prepared CPU observation -> Backend.plan -> CPU action; 1 VLM + 1 streaming DiT
protocol.state_reset: per-config bootstrap snapshot; clone buffers/cache and restore all RNG outside timing
protocol.validation: full 40x7 decoded continuous CPU action chunk and projected commands; per-config bootstrap error propagates; finite only guard
protocol.input: Spatial episode 0 frame 20; fresh visual; action delay1 image age0 fixed demo prefix
protocol.coverage: 192 structurally selected DiT Linear sites; not dynamic GEMM-call coverage
protocol.quantization_scope: 192 candidate DiT Linears only; VLM and noncandidate DiT remain BF16
protocol.optimization_bundle: Shared fusion=all and DiT Graph; integer tiers also use norm/modulation and residual/norm quantization fusion
protocol.quality: fixed-input replay diagnostics only; no closed-loop runs requested or performed

value.modification_scope: 192-site progressive selection and mixed-bit producer adaptation; no owned CUDA source edits
